instances.claim: This tells me that the object was under some pressure to stop existing as a physical thing, and that a context named earlier is what held it in existence.
instances.why: "remained" and "buoyed into physicality" both push against a state of affairs the draft never puts on screen — nothing before line 5 says the object was dissolving, being withdrawn, or at risk of becoming immaterial — and "its context" is a definite phrase for a force no earlier line identifies. Lines 1–4 establish only a price discrepancy and a mass-produced coin, neither of which is a threat to the object's physicality.

instances.claim: This tells me that CENTS is a fixed, countable set of individual cents, identical at the outset, each one held and handled by a participant.
instances.why: "Every Cent", "Each object, initially identical" and "its participants" are claims about a bounded collection and its membership, but the only collection the draft ever counts is the five hundred billion circulating Lincoln cents in line 4 — not the set that is removed from circulation, photographed, destroyed, inscribed and marked by touch. The set those quantifiers range over, and the people acting on it, are never introduced.
